Sharp Quiz - What Sharp Quiz is
Sharp Quiz is a mobile quiz app. The public website describes it as a quiz application for programming skills and general knowledge, aimed at tech enthusiasts, programming learners, and curious minds.
The homepage headline is "Challenge your young Geniuses!" and "Sharp Quiz - Elevate Your Programming Skills and General Knowledge".
Page title and meta description on the site: "Sharp quiz | Quiz app | Programming quiz". The description says: Elevate your coding skills and general knowledge with Sharp Quiz - the best quiz app for learning and competition. Test your knowledge with educational games and programming quiz challenges.
The site invites people to download the app, join a community, share insights, discuss quiz questions, and connect with other learners.

Sharp Quiz - Download the app
The website offers "DOWNLOAD APP" and "SCAN QR CODE AND DOWNLOAD".
Google Play listing: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sharpquiz&hl=en-IN
The homepage embeds a demo video: https://www.youtube.com/embed/5Yn7CL9U_q4
Site sections linked from the page: Home, About, FAQ, Contact Us, and Privacy Policy at https://sharpquiz.com/privacy-policy

Sharp Quiz - Website FAQ > What is Sharp Quiz?
Sharp Quiz is a quiz application for tech enthusiasts, programming learners, and curious minds. It offers quizzes that test programming skills and general knowledge.

metadata.section: Website FAQ > What is Sharp Quiz?

Sharp Quiz - Website FAQ > Quiz topics on the website
The website FAQ says quizzes cover programming languages including PHP, React Native, .NET, Angular, and more, plus general knowledge questions.

text:
Sharp Quiz - Website FAQ > Improving programming skills
The website says Sharp Quiz provides coding challenges and questions tailored to different programming languages. Taking the quizzes is how you test and improve coding skill.

Sharp Quiz - Website FAQ > Getting started
Download the Sharp Quiz app from the app store, create an account, then explore and take the quizzes.

Sharp Quiz - Contact on the website
The site has a Contact us form. Required fields: first name, last name, a valid 10-digit phone number, and a valid email address. The button label is Submit.
The privacy policy says questions about that policy go to sharpquiz@gmail.com.
The footer says Powered By ResilienceSoft and links to https://www.resiliencesoft.com/

Sharp Quiz - Privacy policy > Introduction
The page title is "Privacy Policy for SHARP QUIZ". Sharp Quiz is described as a mobile application developed by Sharp Quiz ("we," "us," or "our"). The policy explains how they collect, use, disclose, and safeguard personal information when you use the Sharp Quiz app. Downloading, installing, or using the app means you agree to the policy. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

Sharp Quiz - Privacy policy > Information the policy says may be collected
Information you provide: name, email address, and user-generated content such as quiz answers, comments, and feedback.
Usage information: how you use the app, including device type and operating system, app usage data such as quiz scores and preferences, and log information such as IP address and access times.

metadata.section: Privacy policy > Information the policy says may be collected

text:
Sharp Quiz - Privacy policy > How the policy says information is used
To deliver and maintain the app, personalize the experience, and improve the service.
To respond to inquiries, provide customer support, and send updates and notifications related to the app.
To analyze how users interact with the app and improve functionality.

metadata.section: Privacy policy > How the policy says information is used

text:
Sharp Quiz - Privacy policy > Disclosure
The policy says Sharp Quiz does not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties without consent. It may disclose information when required by law, court order, or government authority.

Sharp Quiz - Privacy policy > Security and changes
The policy says they take reasonable measures to protect personal information, but no method of transmission or electronic storage is entirely secure, and they cannot guarantee absolute security.
They may update the policy and will notify users by posting the updated policy on the website or in the app. Continued use after changes is acknowledgment of the updated policy.

Sharp Quiz - Privacy policy > Privacy contact
Questions about the privacy policy: sharpquiz@gmail.com

Sharp Quiz - Google Play listing > Store identity
Listing name: Sharp Quiz - GK & Programming. Developer: RESILIENCESOFT. Short description: Sharp Quiz: A Best Quiz App For General Knowledge, Current Affairs & Programming.
The public listing shows a 4.8 star rating, 10K+ downloads, content rating 3+, categories Trivia and Multiple-choice, single player. Updated on Jul 27, 2026.
What's new on that update: target Android SDK 36 for Google Play requirements, compatibility with newer Android devices, stability improvements, dependency updates, and performance enhancements.

Sharp Quiz - Google Play listing > What the listing says the app does
Sharp Quiz is a quiz app for students, programmers, and government exam aspirants. It offers MCQ practice, current affairs, and AI-powered features.
Programming and coding quizzes named on the listing: PHP, React and React Native, .NET and C#, Angular, Python, Java, C, C++, and more.
AI Topic Quiz Generator: enter a topic and the app generates quiz questions. The listing says this is for topic-wise revision, quick practice before exams, and learning without searching.
Document to Quiz Generator: upload a PDF (notes, books, study material) and the app creates quiz questions from it. The listing mentions exam notes, coaching material, and self-study PDFs.
Current affairs and daily quiz: national and international current affairs for UPSC, SSC, Banking, Railway, and State Government Exams, plus daily quizzes.
Quiz categories on the listing: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Maths, Reasoning, English, Programming Languages, Basics of Computers, Sports, Indian History, Constitution of India, Indian Geography, General Science, Indian Economy.
Other features named: topic-wise MCQs, practice tests, daily challenges, progress and accuracy tracking, competing with friends and leaderboards, and a simple fast interface.

text:
Q: What is Sharp Quiz?
A: Sharp Quiz is a mobile quiz app for programming skills, general knowledge, current affairs, and exam practice. It is published by ResilienceSoft.

Q: Where can I download Sharp Quiz?
A: Download Sharp Quiz on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sharpquiz&hl=en-IN The website also has a QR code and a DOWNLOAD APP button.

Q: Which programming languages does Sharp Quiz cover?
A: The website FAQ names PHP, React Native, .NET, and Angular. The Google Play listing also names React, C#, Python, Java, C, and C++.

Q: Does Sharp Quiz have an AI quiz generator?
A: The Google Play listing describes an AI Topic Quiz Generator: enter a topic and the app generates questions. It also describes a Document to Quiz Generator that creates questions from an uploaded PDF.

Q: Which exams does Sharp Quiz mention?
A: The Google Play listing says current affairs and daily quizzes are designed for UPSC, SSC, Banking, Railway, and State Government Exams.

Q: How do I contact Sharp Quiz?
A: Privacy-policy questions on the website go to sharpquiz@gmail.com. Google Play lists support email sharpquizapp@gmail.com. The developer on Play is RESILIENCESOFT, info@resiliencesoft.com, +91 91099 11372. The website also has a Contact us form (first name, last name, 10-digit phone, email).

Q: Does Sharp Quiz sell my personal information?
A: The website privacy policy says Sharp Quiz does not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties without consent. It may disclose information when required by law.

Q: Who makes Sharp Quiz?
A: The website footer says Powered By ResilienceSoft (https://www.resiliencesoft.com/). Google Play lists the developer as RESILIENCESOFT, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh.
